WIRobotics announces Ottobock distribution partnership starting in the US

The agreement covers the US and Canada, with an initial US launch; medical applications require separate agreements and regulatory authorization.

PR Newswire / WIRobotics ↗16 November 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A newly disclosed distribution agreement

On November 16, WIRobotics disclosed that its US subsidiary signed a distribution agreement with Otto Bock HealthCare on October 15. WIRobotics will supply the WIM S wearable mobility robot, with Ottobock acting as a distribution partner for the US and Canada. The disclosure date is distinct from the signing date.

Online sales and selected trial locations

The partnership starts in the US through Ottobock’s direct-to-consumer platform and the WIRobotics USA online store, with trials planned at selected orthotic and prosthetic clinics. The companies will collaborate on training, after-sales support and market development. Customer feedback will inform additional trial locations and expansion of sales into Canada.

Medical ambitions have separate requirements

The company reports more than 4,000 cumulative WIM sales; this is a product-family total, not a new Ottobock order. WIM Medi remains under development for medical use. Entry into medical and rehabilitation channels in either country would require applicable authorization and a separate agreement, rather than following automatically from the WIM S partnership.
